opening.argument: The material presents a warning about a Netflix-related search advertisement leading viewers toward a technical-support destination. Its title identifies an advertisement on Bing leading to tech support scam, while the description warns viewers that scammers use search-engine advertising to lead people to “their company” and expressly says “Beware.” The visuals demonstrate the reported pathway: an independent support page offers Netflix-related help, a telephone number, callback request, and chat, followed by a remote-desktop authorization prompt. These observations support an investigative warning, not an invitation to use the service. The available evidence does not establish who operated the service, whether the prompt was accepted, or whether anyone suffered a loss.

citations.quote: Ad for Netflix on Bing leads to tech support scam
Scammers are buying ad space on popular search engines to lead people to their company.
